properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES primitives available via node-forge@1.3.1 in the pinned dependency tree — transitive (yarn.lock only, no workspace declaration, no first-party import). AES is quantum-resistant (Grover halves to 128-bit security at 256-bit keys); recorded for dependency completeness — the build ships the algorithm whether or not the application calls it.
